'''Ulumahal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillian]] who defined the role of [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She transformed [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] from illegal front to the jewel known during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TJoY" />
